findings.text: non-blocking: the sentence says 'neither arm converges in sixty updates' and then gives the count that refutes it in the same clause, '0 of 16 warm lanes, 1 of 16 cold'; the committed record's cold arm carries one true entry in its converged array and one lane at 26 updates, so a reader who stops at 'neither' takes a stronger claim than the record supports.

non-blocking: the column headed 'terminal residual, lane 0' carries 4.1e-12 for the reference row, but scripts/prototypes/bank_warm_stall/compact.py:83 stores max() over the sixteen lanes for that arm (lane 0 is 3.396e-12), so one column mixes two conventions and only the two 1.01 arms are lane-0 values.

non-blocking: the reference entry records revision None while the warm and cold entries carry 5f34f03c4a850904ec0432db511adf5ba3ac0133, so the record cannot state which base the control arm ran at and a reader must fall back to the fragment's job note.

non-blocking: the figure now sets a linear y-range from the data and drops axes.set_yscale('log'), but the section's brief specifies a log y-axis for this figure and the caption's '9.7 decades below this range' now annotates a note on a linear panel; the traces read correctly and the divergence is clearer than a tolerance-scaled log axis, so this is a stated deviation rather than a misleading figure.
non-blocking: --lane is parsed and never used, so a caller passing it gets no error and no effect.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion anywhere -- render.py's compare() and summary() are a report, not a check -- so nothing reddens if a later edit reintroduces the 'within 0.3% for all sixty updates' claim the previous review caught; the record survives reclamation only because compact.py can rebuild it, which I verified by running it, not by a test.
justifications.evidence: scripts/prototypes/bank_warm_stall/compact.py regenerated the committed results/bank-warm-stall.json byte for byte from wp/report.json plus the unity job's SUMMARY line, render.py --summary reproduced every figure the prose quotes, and plot.py re-rendered the committed SVG except for generation ids, so the artefact's provenance holds under re-execution.
justifications.fit: the added code follows the prototype idiom and the repository style (nova.media.ink style(), a 14x7.2 canvas, no gridlines, despined, legend above the panel) with no plan or version label in any name, but scripts/prototypes/bank_warm_stall/plot.py:41 parses a --lane option the script never reads.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-warm-stall.html:35-41 now states the measured warm-against-cold divergence and takes the reference arm's terminal residual from the record, but the same file's line 6 still says 'neither arm converges in sixty updates' while its own clause records 1 of 16 cold lanes converged.
justifications.reuse: searched scripts/prototypes and tests for a reduced-record summariser and for an existing compare() owner (bank_solve_cycle/report.py:66 compares base against head, a different capability); render.py's compare()/summary() and compact.py's reference() extend the modules that already own the record rather than forking another's mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 22ca7d05a 1661bb3b4 lists exactly the fragment, the SVG, compact.py, plot.py, render.py and results/bank-warm-stall.json, all inside the three declared write paths, with no product code and no test touched.
